Retrospective/Chart Review Planning Outline

Use with your mentor to develop a feasible study. This is an educational planning aid, not an approved IRB protocol or a substitute for current institutional templates.

Click a shaded field to replace its prompt. Edits stay in this page only and reset on refresh. Use Print / Save as PDF to retain your work. Use nonconfidential planning text.

· Project Examples Library

Question and Design

[Focused question; rationale; retrospective cohort, case-control, descriptive chart review, or other appropriate design.]

Cohort and Time Origin

[Setting, dates, eligibility, index date, exclusions, and follow-up window. Explain how the available records identify the cohort.]

Variables and Abstraction

[Primary outcome, exposure/comparator, covariates, definitions, source fields, abstraction rules, quality checks, and any chart validation.]

Feasibility

[Defensible expected eligible sample/events; data access; abstraction workload; personnel; project timeline and resources.]

Analysis and Bias

[Primary estimand/comparison; confounding strategy; missingness; repeated measures if applicable; sensitivity analyses; precision/sample justification.]

Privacy and Review

[Who accesses which records; data minimization, linkage/key separation, storage and retention. Discuss consent/HIPAA requirements or any requested waiver with the IRB; do not assume eligibility.]

Interpretation and Submission

[What the design can and cannot conclude. Transfer the plan into the current official LSU Health Data and Specimen Analysis template, or another template directed by the IRB.]
